Usage: kit [options] <command>

Develop, build and ship projects

Commands:
  init      Create a new project
  build, b  Build the project
  test      Run the tests
  graph     Print the build graph
  sync      Fetch and fast-forward every repository
  repo      Manage the repositories
  lock      Refresh the lock files
  doctor    Diagnose the environment

Options:
  -v, --verbose  Print more output

Output:
  How results are shown
  --color <auto|always|never>  When to colour the output [default: auto]
